sidekiq: suss: this pack's own name, used as RubyPack.name and as boundaryBinding recognition; also the message-bus technology its channels are on
jobClasses: suss: RbJobPattern variant tag, defined in @suss/adapter-ruby
perform: Sidekiq: the instance method Sidekiq::Job requires, which a worker runs with the job's arguments
set: Sidekiq: Sidekiq::Job::ClassMethods#set, which returns a setter with queue or retry options for the enqueue after it
sidekiq_options: Sidekiq: Sidekiq::Job::ClassMethods#sidekiq_options, which declares a job's queue and retry options
queue: Sidekiq: the sidekiq_options keyword the job's queue is given under
